feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 27 October 2026 12:03pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 27 October 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Deep area of low pressure will track to the north of Scotland and begin to fill, weak fronts will affect the Irish Sea at first tomorrow.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 6 or 7, decreasing 5 or 6 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, falling moderate tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, patchy rain for a time later.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers or rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Soon decreasing West or Southwest 4 or 5 tomorrow afternoon, then Southwest 3 or 4 in the evening. Backing South or Southwest overnight into Thursday, increasing 4 or 5 on Thursday morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair, then patchy drizzle later.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in any drizzle later.
